figurative_meaning_en: consecutive births (siblings born one after another)
example_sentences_in_bangla: পিঠাপিঠি ভাইবোনের মধ্যে বন্ধুত্বটা সবসময় গাঢ় থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: Their two sons were born back-to-back.
Back-to-back siblings often share a close bond.
note: Refers to closely spaced births in family contexts
